headline: Is Universal Health Services (UHS) Undervalued After Its Buyback Completion And Q2 2026 Earnings?
summary: Universal Health Services (UHS) is back in focus after the company completed a long running share repurchase program and released its second quarter 2026 earnings, prompting investors to reassess the stock. See our latest analysis for Universal Health Services. Over the past year Universal Health Services has delivered a 1 year total shareholder return of 2.36%, while the share price is down 23.65% year to date and recently traded at $167.87.
